name: nats
description: NATS 2.14 (the public nats:2.14.10-alpine by digest) with JetStream on a data volume at /data, every message fsynced, a JetStream domain named after the service, a leaf node listener on 7422 for one leaf user whose password is the NATS_LEAF_PASSWORD secret, and monitoring on 8222. Clients on 4222 need no login: only linked services reach it. A link gives NATS_URL.
